books.title: Kavero’s Kitchen Capers
books.concept: Big questions, small snacks, and a wonderfully messy kitchen: funny adventures in cooking, serving, and sharing, with adults handling heat and sharp tools.

stories.title: The Sandwich That Slid
stories.summary: Kavero stacks everyone’s favourite fillings into one sandwich, but Granny needs a plate big enough to catch lunch as it escapes sideways.

stories.title: The Recipe Without Numbers
stories.summary: Granny’s “a little” and “some” send Kavero searching for the measuring cup her hands seem to have swallowed.

stories.title: The Very Fancy Lunch
stories.summary: Kavero serves tiny restaurant portions with enormous descriptions, until Dad politely asks when lunch will begin.

stories.title: The Pancake Portrait
stories.summary: With Mum cooking, the friends design pancake faces—but each face looks more like somebody else when it lands on the plate.

stories.title: The Great Pea Escape
stories.summary: Kavero tries to arrange a perfectly neat dinner while his peas keep rolling into Granny’s potatoes.

stories.title: The Toast Appointment
stories.summary: Kavero prepares an elaborate breakfast timetable, then discovers that warm toast refuses to stay warm while everyone finds a seat.

stories.title: The Lopsided Cake
stories.summary: A cake leans to one side, so Kavero and Granny decorate it as a hill—and Pip insists that every hill needs a picnic.

stories.title: The Alphabet Soup Lunch
stories.summary: Kavero wants to serve everyone’s name in alphabet soup, but the letter everyone needs is hiding in somebody else’s bowl.

stories.title: The Crunchy Music Club
stories.summary: The friends make a snack-time orchestra with crunchy foods, only to discover that their instruments disappear during rehearsals.

stories.title: The Great Banana Vote
stories.summary: Kavero lets the family vote on what to make with ripe bananas, and Granny has to remind the committee that the bananas are still waiting.

stories.title: The Picnic in Cups
stories.summary: Kavero serves an entire little picnic in cups, then discovers that a sandwich does not enjoy being folded quite that much.

stories.title: The Biscuit Shapes Parade
stories.summary: Millie names every biscuit shape before baking, and Kavero must explain why her tiny rabbit has spread into an enormous cloud.

stories.title: The Two-Sided Pizza
stories.summary: Kavero and Poppy divide a pizza into favourite-topping territories, but the cheese refuses to respect their carefully drawn border.

stories.title: The Invisible Table
stories.summary: Kavero decorates the dinner table so thoroughly that Granny can find the flowers, the ribbons, and the name cards—but nowhere for dinner.

stories.title: The Ice-Lolly Queue
stories.summary: Kavero checks the freezer every few minutes, while Granny helps him discover that the hardest ingredient in ice lollies is waiting.

stories.title: The Thank-You Supper
stories.summary: Kavero plans a supper to thank Granny, then has to find her a special guest’s job that does not involve helping him make it.

books.title: Kavero’s Outdoor Escapades
books.concept: Small adventures in the garden, park, and neighbourhood: Kavero explores with Granny and his friends, discovering how much there is to notice close to home.

stories.title: The Map Forgot Us
stories.summary: Kavero’s map includes every interesting landmark but nowhere to begin, so Granny asks him to draw the very important spot under their shoes.

stories.title: The Perfect Picnic Spot
stories.summary: Everyone wants something different from the perfect picnic spot, and Granny would mainly like to sit down before lunch becomes dinner.

stories.title: The Smallest Expedition
stories.summary: Kavero packs for a grand adventure across the garden, while Millie keeps finding reasons to stop after three steps.

stories.title: The Puddle Path
stories.summary: Kavero plans a walk that avoids every puddle, but his dry route keeps bringing the friends back to Granny’s front gate.

stories.title: The Pocketful of Outdoors
stories.summary: Kavero wants to take a little of the park home, until Granny helps him choose drawings and memories instead of stuffing his pockets with everything.

stories.title: The Cloud Appointment
stories.summary: The friends arrange to show Granny a cloud shaped like a rabbit, but their rabbit becomes a teapot before she arrives.

stories.title: The Windy Hat Walk
stories.summary: Kavero spends a breezy walk holding his hat with both hands, leaving Granny to ask how he plans to point at all his discoveries.

stories.title: The Backwards Binoculars
stories.summary: Millie looks through binoculars the wrong way round and declares that their tiny garden has become an enormous country.

stories.title: The Leaf Fashion Show
stories.summary: Kavero and his friends arrange fallen leaves into imaginary outfits, but a breeze rearranges the entire collection just before Granny’s judging begins.

stories.title: The Bench-to-Bench Adventure
stories.summary: Granny chooses a walk with plenty of sitting stops, and Kavero gives each bench a different pretend destination.

stories.title: The Quietest Garden Visit
stories.summary: Kavero promises a quiet morning watching birds, but communicating his excitement without shouting turns out to require his whole body.

stories.title: The Enormous Small Hill
stories.summary: Pip describes a grassy slope as a mountain, and Kavero’s expedition discovers that Granny has reached the summit carrying their snacks.

stories.title: The Long Shadow Parade
stories.summary: On an afternoon walk, the children stretch their shadows across the path and try to fit their enormous pretend selves around Granny’s ordinary-sized feet.

stories.title: The Garden Welcome Party
stories.summary: Kavero prepares a welcome party for a newly planted sapling, then learns that his guest needs space, water, and fewer decorations.

stories.title: The Walk With No List
stories.summary: When Kavero leaves his outing checklist at home, Poppy suggests choosing one thing at a time—and an unplanned stop becomes everyone’s favourite.

stories.title: The Grand Outdoor Report
stories.summary: Kavero invites the family to hear his report of the neighbourhood, but Granny’s favourite discoveries are the funny little moments he forgot to put on his map.
